status: Demo: synthetic teaching inputs, not selected equipment or validated sizing
weather_source: Synthetic analytic profiles; no downloaded weather
notes: PV uses a synthetic daylight sine, not a site-specific irradiance calculation.
Cooling, temperature, humidity and CO2 are scripted demo signals, not an EnergyPlus or ventilation model.
Battery flows are AC-bus power; charge and discharge conversion losses are accounted for in stored energy.
Grid export is disabled; surplus after charging is curtailed. No tariff or savings claim.
Water volumes use mass balance. Pipe sizing, pressure, treatment and pump curves are not modelled.
The non-potable rainwater loop never joins the utility-supplied domestic water loop.
